name: spasht
description: Spasht - voice-first loan clarity co-pilot. Concept demo for the Paytm Build for India AI Hackathon. Synthetic data only.

scripts.migrate: node scripts/run.mjs backend alembic upgrade head
scripts.test: node scripts/run.mjs backend python -m pytest && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.lint: node scripts/run.mjs backend python -m ruff check . && node scripts/run.mjs backend python -m ruff format --check . && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm run secret-scan
scripts.contracts: node scripts/run.mjs backend --env SPASHT_WRITE_CONTRACTS=1 python -m pytest tests/test_contracts.py -q
scripts.format: node scripts/run.mjs backend python -m ruff check --fix . && node scripts/run.mjs backend python -m ruff format . && npm --prefix frontend run lint:fix
scripts.audit: node scripts/run.mjs backend python -m pip_audit --progress-spinner off; npm --prefix frontend audit
